!2 Through the proxy

The same three pages, but !-FitNesse-! launches the proxy, and the proxy forwards to a
!-SlimVerify-! host on port ${VERIFY_HOST_PORT}. '''No page mentions the proxy''' - it is invisible,
because the target comes from the command line (''--Target='').

The counters of these pages have to match !-DirectSuite-! exactly; the only permitted difference in
the whole result !-XML-! is the port number in ''<command>''.
